items.text: Haiwa Jehovha, meso enyu haatsvaki chokwadi here?
Asi nomwoyo mumwe, naivowo vakanga vavhuna joko,
namaguta avo kuti ibvamburanye vose vanobudamo,
uye vakapika navamwari vasati vari vamwari.
Ivo mabhiza anodya achiguta azere ruchiva,
Naizvozvo zvanzi naJehovha Mwari Wamasimba Ose:
uye vanhu ava kuti vave huni dzinopiswa nawo.
Haiwa imi imba yaIsraeri," ndizvo zvinotaura Jehovha,
rudzi rwakare kare uye rudzi rwakashinga,
maguta enyu akakomberedzwa iwo amunovimba nawo.
"Kunyange mumazuva iwayo," ndizvo zvinotaura Jehovha, "handingakuparadzei zvachose.

Zvino kana vanhu vakabvunza kuti, 'Ko, Jehovha Mwari wedu aitirei izvi kwatiri?' imi muchavaudza kuti, 'Sezvo makandisiya mukandoshumira vamwari vavatorwa munyika yenyu chaiyo, saizvozvowo zvino muchashandira vatorwa munyika isiri yenyu.'
Inzwai izvi imi mapenzi navanhu vasina pfungwa,
Ko, hamufaniri kunditya here?" ndizvo zvinotaura Jehovha.
Ndakaita jecha kuti rive muganhu wegungwa,
Asi vanhu ava vane mwoyo yakasindimara uye inondimukira;
anotipa mvura yaMatsutso neyoMunakamwe nenguva yayo,
zvivi zvenyu zvakadzivisa kuti zvinhu zvakanaka zviuye kwamuri.
vanovandira kufanana savanhu vanoteya shiri nougombe
uye savaya vanoisa misungo yokubata vanhu.
Ko, handifaniri kuvaranga pane izvi here?"
